messages.author: dc8e2a2822af1a36
messages.subject: Help installing rattle
parts:
Dear Friends,

I tried installing rattle today. Everything appeared to go without
error until I invoked rattle() at the R prompt. I received the
following error message:

Error in rattle() : could not find function "gladeXMLNew"

I am using Linux Suse 10.2 and the most recent version of R. I also
installed the most recent version of libglade.

Can anyone help?

Joe

messages.author: dc8e2a2822af1a36
messages.subject: Re: Help installing rattle
parts:
Dear Friends,

I found my own solution. I needed to close R and the shell terminal,
then reenter. I hope this is useful to anyone with a similar problem.

Joe
